group-2023-i-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇关于“自我宽恕（Personal Forgiveness）”的说明文，主题是：犯错是人之常情，除了承担责任，更要学会原谅自己。文章给出一套书面练习——分别列出“个人优点”和“善举”，并可邀请亲友补充——来帮助读者重建自信、看待错误。五个空分别考查段首主题句、段内衔接句与段尾总结句。

discourseStructure.summary: 全文按“提出观点—具体方法—延伸建议—总结升华”推进。首段提出要原谅自己并引出写作练习；第二、三段给出两项具体清单（个人优点、善举）；第四段建议请亲友参与补充；末段回到“从错误中成长”的主旨收束。

units.heading: Personal Forgiveness
units.summary: 提出核心观点：承担责任之余也要原谅自己，并引出后文的写作练习。
给出两项具体练习：在“个人优点”页列出自身长处，在“善举”页列出为他人做过的好事。
建议邀请亲友帮忙补充清单，彼此交流各自的闪光点，并指出这是随时提升自信的好办法。
回到主旨：人多从错误而非成功中学习，错误是发展与成长的积极途径。

contextEvidence.afterQuote: You can use the following writing exercise to help you do this.

mechanismSignals.targetText: Personal Forgiveness / don’t beat yourself up
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 show yourself some forgiveness 与标题 Personal Forgiveness、前句 don’t beat yourself up 同属“自我宽恕”话题场。
前句“别苛责自己”与选项“原谅自己”语义呼应。
空后 do this 中的 this 指代空格句提出的“原谅自己”这件事。

optionFit.fitSummary: 首段先说承担责任之余别苛责自己、犯错是人之常情，空格句承接说“同样重要的是给自己一些宽恕”，紧扣标题 Personal Forgiveness，且空后 do this 即指代它。

matchedClues.contextSide: don’t beat yourself up / To err is human
matchedClues.relation: 前句铺垫犯错难免、勿苛责，选项顺势提出“自我宽恕”这一同样重要的做法。
this 回指空格句所说的“原谅自己”，构成指代衔接。

keyDistractors.reason: E 句 It doesn’t mean... 需要前文有可被 it 指代的对象，放此处指代关系不成立，且未点出“自我宽恕”这一与标题呼应的关键。

q-2023-i-036.teachingNote: 段首/段中空若紧扣标题关键词并被后文代词回指，优先选与主题场一致、能被 this 指代的句子。

topicClues: aspects of your personality that you’re proud of

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 characteristics you like about yourself 正是对标题 Personal Strengths（个人优点）的展开。
前面的小标题 Personal Strengths 限定本段要列的是“你喜欢的自身特质”。

mechanismSignals.signalText: aspects of your personality that you’re proud of
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后“你引以为傲的性格方面”与选项中 you like about yourself 同义复现。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段以“Personal Strengths”为标题，空格作为段内指令句承上启下，要求“现在列出你喜欢的自身特质”，正好领起后面 Are you caring? Creative? 等具体特质的追问。

matchedClues.contextSide: Personal Strengths / aspects of your personality that you’re proud of
matchedClues.optionSide: list all the characteristics you like about yourself
matchedClues.relation: 标题与后文的性格特质问句都指向“列出自身优点”，与选项的 list...characteristics 完全对应。

keyDistractors.reason: F 句 Whatever it is, ...write it down 是第三段“善举”清单的收尾用语，话题与列举“个人优点”错位。

q-2023-i-037.teachingNote: 紧跟小标题的指令型空格，选与标题同义、并能领起下文具体例子的“列出/Now list...”类句子。

topicClues: list all the positive things you’ve done for others
helped a friend with their homework

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: when you baked cookies after the family had had a tiring day.

mechanismSignals.targetText: helped a friend with their homework / did the ironing / baked cookies
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项中的 it 回指前文列举的各种善举，构成对前面例子的概括指代。

mechanismSignals.targetText: list all the positive things you’ve done for others
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 write it down 与本段开头 list...the positive things 同属“记录善举”话题场，构成段尾收束。

mechanismSignals.signalText: list all the positive things you’ve done for others
mechanismSignals.targetText: no matter how small it might seem, write it down
mechanismSignals.relation: 前文要求“列出为他人做过的好事”，空格句以“无论多小都写下来”作收束，话题一致。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段在“Acts of Kindness”下列举了帮同学、做家务、烤饼干等小善举，段尾空格用“无论它是什么、无论看起来多小，都把它写下来”作总结，it 回指这些例子，呼应段首的 list...positive things。

matchedClues.contextSide: helped a friend / did the ironing / baked cookies
matchedClues.optionSide: Whatever it is, no matter how small it might seem, write it down
matchedClues.relation: it 概括指代前文列举的各类小善举，并要求统统记下来。

keyDistractors.reason: A 句谈 self-forgiveness 主题，与本段“善举清单”话题不符，且无法回指前文具体例子。

q-2023-i-038.teachingNote: 段尾总结空若前文是一串具体例子，优先选含 Whatever it is / it 回指并给出统一动作（write it down）的概括句。

topicClues: ask a friend or family member to help
what makes each of you special

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: You could ask a friend or family member to help add to your list.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: That way, you could exchange thoughts on what makes each of you special

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项主语 They 回指前句的 a friend or family member，形成人称指代衔接。

mechanismSignals.signalText: have a go at doing the exercise
mechanismSignals.targetText: exchange thoughts on what makes each of you special
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 do the exercise 与空后“彼此交流各自闪光点”同属“亲友共同参与练习”话题场。

mechanismSignals.signalText: exchange thoughts on what makes each of you special
mechanismSignals.targetText: have a go at doing the exercise
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 each of you 暗示亲友也参与进来，正承接选项“他们也想试做这练习”。

optionFit.fitSummary: 前句提到可请亲友帮忙补充清单，空格句顺势说“他们甚至可能也想试着做做这项练习”，They 回指 a friend or family member，并为空后“That way 彼此交流各自闪光点”作铺垫。

matchedClues.contextSide: ask a friend or family member / exchange thoughts on what makes each of you special
matchedClues.optionSide: They might even like to have a go at doing the exercise
matchedClues.relation: They 指代亲友，他们也参与做练习，才有了后文的“彼此交流”。

keyDistractors.reason: A 句的 self-forgiveness 与本段“请亲友参与”逻辑无关，且 also goes a long way 无可指代的前项支撑。

q-2023-i-039.teachingNote: 段中衔接空若前句出现可被指代的人物，且后句用 That way 承接，优先选用 They 回指并解释“怎样做到”的句子。

topicClues: learn not from their successes but their mistakes
We’re all changing and learning all the time
mistakes are a positive way to develop and grow

contextEvidence.afterQuote: We’re all changing and learning all the time and mistakes are a positive way to develop and grow.

mechanismSignals.targetText: learn not from their successes but their mistakes
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项关键词 mistake 与前文 learn...from their mistakes 同属“错误”话题场。

mechanismSignals.signalText: it isn’t a fixed aspect of your personality
mechanismSignals.targetText: We’re all changing and learning all the time
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项“错误不是性格中固定的一面”与空后“我们一直在变化和学习”形成“可变、可成长”的语义呼应。

mechanismSignals.signalText: We’re all changing and learning all the time
mechanismSignals.targetText: it isn’t a fixed aspect of your personality
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后“我们一直在变化与学习”正解释了为什么错误并非固定不变，承接选项。

optionFit.fitSummary: 末段指出人多从错误而非成功中学习，空格句承接说“无论犯什么错，记住它都不是你性格中固定不变的一面”，与空后“我们一直在变化学习、错误是成长的积极途径”逻辑相扣。

matchedClues.contextSide: learn...from their mistakes / We’re all changing and learning all the time
matchedClues.optionSide: Whatever the mistake, remember it isn’t a fixed aspect of your personality
matchedClues.relation: 错误话题贯穿前后，选项强调错误可变，正引出后文“变化、成长”。

keyDistractors.reason: A 句 self-forgiveness 已在首段方向使用，置于末段无法与“错误→成长”的论证链衔接。

q-2023-i-040.teachingNote: 承上启下的段中空，抓住前后共同话题词（mistake）并选能解释后文“变化/成长”原因的句子。
